title: One project, two kinds of investor
subtitle: Public and private capital converge on the same funding table.

firstStep.title: A project goes live
firstStep.description: A water infrastructure project is published with a funding goal and milestones.

secondStep.title: Government anchors it
secondStep.description: A government position, tagged public, signals the project is validated.

thirdStep.title: Community co-invests
thirdStep.description: Local residents, diaspora, and outside investors fund the rest, tagged private.

fourthStep.title: Milestones get verified
fourthStep.description: Progress and impact are recorded on-chain as the project delivers.

summary: Public and private capital, one dashboard, fully on-chain.
photoAlt: A municipal representative and a community member inspecting water-treatment infrastructure together.
